  - region "Simple English explanation of Variable-Separable Equations":
    - group:
      - text: In simple English
      - heading "Understand Variable-Separable Equations" [level=2]
  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS
    - heading "Variable-Separable Equations" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Solve first-order differential equations of the form dy/dx = f(x)g(y) by separating variables, integrating, and applying initial conditions.
    - text: 20 min ADVANCED CONCEPT solver visualized
    - heading "❶ DRAG TO SEPARATE VARIABLES" [level=3]
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - paragraph: Start with dy/dx = xy
    - paragraph: "Drag factors to separate variables: move dy/y to the left and x dx to the right."
    - heading "y-side (only y and dy)" [level=3]
    - button "y"
    - button "dy"
    - text: =
    - heading "x-side (only x and dx)" [level=3]
    - button "x"
    - button "dx"
    - text: Available y-factors Available x-factors
    - button "◎ Check separation"
    - text: ✓ Correct separation! dy/y = x dx
    - article:
      - heading "❷ INTEGRATE BOTH SIDES" [level=3]
      - text: Integrate left ∫ 1/y dy = ln|y| Integrate right ∫ x dx = x²/2 ln|y| = x²/2 + C
      - paragraph: ✓ Integration step correct
    - article:
      - heading "❸ SOLVE FOR y" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Exponentiate both sides and absorb eᶜ into a new arbitrary constant C.
      - text: y = Ceˣ²⁄²
      - paragraph: ✓ Exponentiation step correct
    - complementary:
      - heading "SLOPE FIELD & SOLUTION CURVE" [level=3]
      - text: "Equation:"
      - combobox "Equation:":
        - option "dy/dx = xy" [selected]
        - option "dy/dx = y"
      - img "Slope field and draggable solution point"
      - paragraph: Drag the blue point on the curve.
      - slider "Curve point x": "0.5"
      - text: "Point: (0.5, 2.2663) Slope from curve: 1.1331 xy at point: 1.1331 Difference:"
      - strong: 0 ✓
      - paragraph: ⓘ The slope field shows y′ = xy everywhere. The blue curve satisfies the differential equation.
      - article:
        - heading "❹ APPLY INITIAL CONDITION" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Given y(0)=2 and y=Ceˣ²⁄²:"
        - text: 2 = Ce⁰ = C C = 2
        - paragraph: "Particular solution:"
        - text: y = 2eˣ²⁄²
        - paragraph: ✓ Constant determined correctly
    - article:
      - heading "◉ DOMAIN & EQUILIBRIUM" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: We divided by y to separate.
        - listitem: The equilibrium solution y(x)=0 also satisfies the equation.
        - listitem: General family includes C positive, negative, or zero.
    - article:
      - heading "◇ ABOUT THE SOLUTION CURVE" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: For C>0 the solution is positive.
        - listitem: For C<0 the solution is negative.
        - listitem: For C=0 it is the equilibrium line.
    - article:
      - heading "◇ CHECK AT YOUR POINT" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "At (0.5, 2.2663) on the curve:"
      - paragraph: y′ = xy = 1.1331
      - paragraph: Curve slope ≈ 1.1331 ✓
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE (TRY ONE YOURSELF)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Solve dy/dx = x/y.
      - list:
        - listitem: "Separate: y dy = x dx"
        - listitem: "Integrate: y²/2 = x²/2 + C"
        - listitem: "Solve: y = ±√(x²+C)"
        - listitem: "Apply y(0)=2: C=4"
        - listitem: "Particular solution: y=+√(x²+4)"
    - article:
      - heading "PRACTICE PROBLEM (TARGETED)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Solve dy/dx = 2xy with y(0)=3.
      - text: 1. Separate left
      - textbox "Separate left"
      - text: 2. Separate right
      - textbox "Separate right"
      - text: 3. Integrated left
      - textbox "Integrated left"
      - text: 4. Integrated right
      - textbox "Integrated right"
      - text: 5. Find C
      - textbox "Find C"
      - text: 6. Particular solution
      - textbox "Particular solution"
      - button "Check all steps"
